mechanism_narrative: A sustained 5-month increase in GDP growth (GDPC1) above its 12-month moving average signals accelerating demand, which historically correlates with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings expectations rise.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 growth above trend does not precede positive SPX returns in at least 60% of triggered instances, or if the Rank IC falls below 0.05 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the industrial production index (INDPRO) below its 6-month moving average signals weakening manufacturing activity, which historically precedes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as profit margins compress.
failure_condition: If INDPRO weakness fails to predict negative SPX returns in more than 70% of triggered instances, or if the Rank IC remains above 0.04 over any 4-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 4.5% triggers a tightening signal that increases discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as equity valuations contract.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS above 4.5% does not precede negative SPX returns in at least 65% of triggered instances, or if the Rank IC exceeds 0.06 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.0% signals labor market weakness, which historically precedes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as consumer spending and corporate profits decline.
failure_condition: If UNRATE above 4.0% fails to predict negative SPX returns in more than 75% of triggered instances, or if the Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month rise in retail sales (RSAFS) above its 6-month moving average signals accelerating consumer demand, which historically correlates with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings expectations improve.
failure_condition: If RSAFS strength above trend does not precede positive SPX returns in at least 55% of triggered instances, or if the Rank IC falls below 0.04 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the housing starts index (HOUST) below its 12-month moving average signals weakening residential construction activity, which historically precedes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as related sectors underperform.
failure_condition: If HOUST weakness fails to predict negative SPX returns in more than 70% of triggered instances, or if the Rank IC exceeds 0.05 over any 4-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) above 200,000 signals labor market strength, which historically correlates with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings expectations rise.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS above 200,000 fails to predict positive SPX returns in at least 60% of triggered instances, or if the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the CPI (CPIAUCSL) below its 12-month moving average signals easing inflationary pressures, which historically correlates with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as real interest rates fall.
failure_condition: If CPI below trend fails to predict positive SPX returns in more than 65% of triggered instances, or if the Rank IC exceeds 0.05 over any 4-year rolling window.
